title: Arts Underground

services.name: Exhibition Archive
services.desc: Are you a Yukon or Atlin, B.C. resident looking to exhibit your artwork? Are you an artist or curator with an incredible idea for an exhibition? Consider submitting a proposal to the Yukon Art Society. On the First Friday of every month, Arts Underground unveils its monthly exhibitions with an opening reception. Art lovers in the community can be the first to see new works by new artists and by some of Yukon’s favourite established artists. It is a chance to explore different cultures, discover something new, and share an enjoyable and inspiring experience with friends.
